gizmo.title: Ukukhangela amagama
gizmo.description: Igridi yoonobumba enamagama afihliweyo. Abafundi bacofa unobumba wokuqala nowokugqibela wegama ngalinye. Iqhelisela ukubona indlela igama elipelwa ngayo, hayi oko lithetha kona.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Oko abafundi bacelwa ukuba bakufumane, kuboniswa kwisihloko.

configure.title: Amagama
configure.description: Amagama aza kufihlwa. Izithuba neziphumlisi zishiywa ngaphandle kwegridi. Amagama angangeniyo adweliswa ngelixa uhlela kwaye ashiywe ngaphandle kubafundi.

advanced.title: Ubungakanani begridi
advanced.description: Oonobumba kwicala ngalinye, 4 ukuya ku-16. Shiya kungenanto ukulinganisa elona gama lide (ukuya ku-12). Ngaphezulu kwe-12 iskrolela ecaleni kwifowuni.

advanced.title: Amagama athambekileyo
advanced.description: Kwakhona fihla amagama ngokuthambekileyo. Kunzima ngakumbi.

advanced.title: Amagama abhalwe ngasemva
advanced.description: Kwakhona fihla amagama abhalwe ngasemva. Kunzima ngakumbi.

advanced.title: Umbala wogxininiso
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa wetshiphu yesihloko, unobumba wokuqala okhethiweyo neqhosha.
